name: Recreus Filaflex 95A Foamy
source: User-authorized Prusa comparison: prusaSlicer.gcode, Generic FLEX, 0.20mm SPEED @MK3; physical material Recreus Filaflex 95 Foamy

flow.reference_line_width_note: Prusa comparison first_layer_extrusion_width=0.42, not a measured foamed bead. Filament multiplier 1.15 combines with the MK3 printer's 0.95 firmware flow once. Raw-input ceiling is 1.2 x 1.15 x 0.95 = 1.311 mm3/s.

retraction.note: Prusa comparison filament_retract_length=0 overrides the printer's retract_length=0.8. Retraction is disabled by the filament profile, not the printer. The optional hop is zero as in the reference's actual print body; required nonplanar clearance remains. Historical FOAM99_45PAIRS seam test (21 October 2026) used 238 C, 1 mm at 40 mm/s, return 20 mm/s and 0.2 mm lift; these historical settings are superseded by the user's 22 October comparison request.

notes: Comparison defaults deliberately follow the supplied successful Prusa print: 240 C, Generic FLEX multiplier 1.15, no filament retraction, commanded first-layer width 0.42 mm and requested first-layer speed 20 mm/s with volumetric limiting. This is an imported comparison setup, not a new physical calibration or a manufacturer Foamy recommendation. No measured bead width is assumed. Two native mesh passes and required raised clearance are retained.
